title: Hagia Sophia
blurb: The 6th-century Church of Holy Wisdom: 82 m long, its 31 m dome rising 55.6 m on pendentives, with semi-domes, 107 columns and four Ottoman minarets.

systems.name: Central dome
systems.description: The 31 m dome, its crown 55.6 m above the floor, with the ring of 40 windows.

systems.name: Pendentives and arches
systems.description: The four pendentives and great arches carrying the dome on the piers.

systems.name: Semi-domes
systems.description: The great eastern and western semi-domes bracing the central dome.

systems.name: Nave
systems.description: The four great piers and the nave colonnades.

systems.name: Aisles
systems.description: Side aisles with outer walls, vaults and columns.

systems.name: Narthex
systems.description: Outer and inner narthex with the entrance doors.

systems.name: Galleries
systems.description: The upper galleries with their columns.

systems.name: Apse
systems.description: The eastern apse with mihrab and minbar from the Ottoman era.

systems.name: Minarets
systems.description: The four Ottoman minarets framing the building.
